passRule: Pass: every hard expectation holds. Speak cases: the named yes/no question must reach 0.8 (the product's bar). Silent cases: 0.5 or less. The two ask-* cases are soft and decide one change only: the "?" pre-filter of the early question is removed only if BOTH land as registered (a plain note no, a request without "?" yes). No retries; one request per pattern.
